| `[col:1, ch:65][col:5, ch:900]` | Success stories with Canonical Ceph |  |  |  | Designed from the ground up for petabyte-scale deployments, Canonical Ceph software defined storage includes only open source components with highly automated operations to drive down total cost of ownership.  If you do not have the in-house expertise to operate your own storage infrastructure, Canonical Ceph is also available as a managed service. [Learn more about Ceph support \>](https://canonical.com/ceph/support) |  |  |  |
| `Image` |  |  |  |  | ![][image2] —-\> \[[Asset link](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1V9hUj9m-IuFgedo9yzUXvWRobnugoQgz/view?usp=drive_link)\] | \[How the Welcome Sanger Institute uses Canonical Ceph\] |  |  |  |
| `Separator` |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| `[col:5, ch:250]` |  |  |  |  | The Wellcome Sanger Institute initially opted for self-maintained Ceph storage, but as their capacity needs grew from 3 PB to over 20 PB, they turned to Canonical to resolve their scaling challenges.  With the help of Canonical support, the Institute's latest Ceph rollout decreased from a month to just four days. Learn how [Wellcome Sanger achieved a cost-effective Ceph infrastructure ›](https://pages.ubuntu.com/rs/066-EOV-335/images/Wellcome%20Sanger%20Institute%20Case%20Study.pdf) |  |  |  |

| `[col:1, ch:65][col:5, ch:900]` | Canonical Ceph deployment and operations |  |  |  | **Deploying Ceph** Canonical can help you to design and install your Ceph cluster, from hardware selection through to integration with the rest of your infrastructure. **Operating Ceph** Day-2 operations are straightforward, thanks to highly automated procedures for software version upgrades and hardware expansions, as well as managing hardware replacement. If you prefer to treat your storage as-a-service, [we offer Managed Ceph](http://ubuntu.com/ceph/managed) – a Ceph cluster fully managed by Canonical. |  |  |  |
| `Image` |  |  |  |  | ![][image9] —-\> \[[Asset link](https://assets.ubuntu.com/v1/a729fd97-edge%2520cloud.png)\] |\] |  |  |  |
| `Separator` |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| `[col:5, ch:250]` |  |  |  |  | **A choice of tooling** The choice is yours: use your own operations framework, or take advantage of the benefits of deploying with Juju and Charms.  Each Ubuntu LTS release ships with a version of Ceph that is supported for up to 15 years.  **Long Term Support (LTS)** To maximize Ceph upgrade flexibility for customers, Ceph versions are regularly released and maintained through Ubuntu updates and security repositories, as well as the Ubuntu Cloud Archive. This maintains the balance between remaining at the forefront of innovation and providing long-term support predictability. **Economic advantage** Consolidate block, file, and object storage workloads into a single Ceph cluster to increase operational efficiency. Repatriate workloads from public clouds to cut costs. Discover [Ceph’s cost benefits](https://ubuntu.com/blog/predict-compare-and-reduce-costs-with-our-s3-cost-calculator), and try our [Ceph pricing calculator](https://ubuntu.com/ceph/pricing-calculator) to learn how much you could save with Ceph.  |  |  |  |
